Domestic Violence Protection Order Data in Colorado in 2024

Author

Andrew MacFarland (andrew.macfarland@cuanschutz.edu)

Published

April 30, 2026

Summary

This report provides an overview of Colorado’s Domestic Violence Protection Order (DVPO) cases in 2024. It is an exploratory analysis and has not been QA’d or approved for distribution!

Case Types and Event Codes

In 2024, the following event_code(s) were filed per case_type n times. Duplicate case_number(s) within an event_code case_type pairing were removed. “Protection Order Domestic Violence” appears to be a data entry artifact or error and were excluded.

Case Pathway Analysis

Here we analyze the potential pathways from initial temporary order hearing to final permanent orders (or lack thereof). These data represent events occurring in 2024; some events are from cases that opened before 2024 or closed after 2024. The analysis ignores vacation of temporary protection orders, because there are hundreds of cases that have a permanent order hearing but never got their temp order vacated, so it’s likely that the data are unreliable. We may want to follow up with a local clerk if possible to get more clarity on the process.

Why the Strange Timing Numbers?

Here is a breakdown of how many days passed between events in the case pathway. Negative numbers indicate that the “first” event occurred after the “second” event (e.g., the temporary protectionorder was recorded as being granted BEFORE the initial temporary protection order hearing). Zero values were removed from histogram plots to highlight non-zero values, number of zero values noted in footnote of each plot.
